prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” marketing agency for everyone — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need full-service, digital, PR, SEO, creative/brand, or B2B expertise. I can help you find the best match if you tell me a few things, or I can give a general shortlist and selection checklist. Quick questions:

- What are your main goals? (brand build, lead gen, e‑commerce sales, PR, SEO, social, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget or the size of the project?
- Industry and target market (local Maryland customers, regional, national)?
- Do you prefer a small local firm, mid-sized agency, or a national agency with a Maryland office?
- Timeline and whether you want ongoing retainers or a one‑time project?

How I can help next
- If you give the details above, I’ll produce a tailored shortlist of Maryland agencies that fit your needs (with pros/cons and estimated pricing ranges).
- Or I can immediately list well-rated Maryland-area agencies and resources to vet them (Clutch, UpCity, Google reviews, Baltimore Business Journal awards), plus a ready-to-use questionnaire to screen agencies.

If you want a quick general checklist to choose now, I can give that too. Which would you prefer?
